text: A car of mass 600 kg travels along a straight horizontal road. The resistance to the car’s motion is
constant and equal to R N.
A and B are two points which are 10 m apart on the same horizontal plane. A particle P starts to move
from rest at A, directly towards B, with constant acceleration 0.5 m s . Another particle Q is moving
directly towards A with constant speed 0.75 m s , and passes through B at the instant that P starts to
move. At time T s after this instant, particles P and Q collide. Find
